import type { Product } from '../entities/Product';

/**
 * Stores catalogue products and their stock. Loaded products are independent
 * copies: changes become visible to other callers only once the product is saved.
 */
export interface ProductRepository {
  findById(id: string): Product | undefined;
  findAll(): Product[];
  save(product: Product): void;
}
